name: Knathtead Excavation
title: Knathtead Excavation
summary: A narrow valley at 63.1S 44.3W that climbs from the Graveyard plain (z 5) to a crystal field at z 82, its walls rising 40-100 m on both sides; about 75 glowing blue crystals carpet the valley head around (13836, 9324) and blue light props line the floor; the Knathtead Mother lairs at its end.

site.name: Knathtead Excavation
site.notes: Derived teleport in the valley 22 m south-west of the crystal field centre, 6 m from the nearest crystal.

shots.standingOrder: Fly up the narrow valley 8 m above its floor toward the glowing blue crystal field and the sun; keep 8 m from both walls.
shots.notes: Canyon run up the narrow Knathtead valley at 6-8 m/s, 8 m above its rising floor between 40-100 m walls, toward the field of 75 glowing blue crystals at its head and into the afternoon sun (backlit glow); the window stops before the camera overflies the field.
